issues.problem: Context 5 (新薬の開発は…で、完成のめどはまだ立たない) fits 試行錯誤 (yj008) about as well.
issues.action: Replaced with 景気は一進一退で、本格的な回復にはまだ時間がかかりそうだ, where only the back-and-forth sense fits.

issues.problem: Context 2 (正直、まだ…だよ) and context 6 (引き継いだ私はしばらく…だった) fit 四苦八苦 (yj018) and 右往左往 (yj022) as well.
issues.action: Added 方向性も見えなくて to context 2; rewrote context 6 as 仕事の全体像が見えず五里霧中だった, so not seeing the way forward is what the situation calls for.

issues.problem: Misuse 2's reason ('not used for people dispersing') overstates the rule: it can describe a group falling into disorder (an army in rout).
issues.action: Reason reworded: it means falling into senseless chaos, not friends simply going their separate ways.

issues.problem: Context 6 (aquarium saved from closing) repeated the situation and shape of context 4 (inn saved from bankruptcy).
issues.action: Replaced with an athlete written off in a slump who wins a tournament: 起死回生の優勝を果たした.

issues.problem: Cue (a chef says her career had many hard times) points as much to 波乱万丈 (yj059) as to a negated 順風満帆.
issues.action: New cue: a friend's café has had queues, great reviews and no problems since opening day.

issues.idiom: 起承転結 / 大器晩成 / 五里霧中
issues.problem: Stories checked: jueju origin (起承転合), Laozi ch. 41 (大器晩成), 後漢書 張楷伝 five-li fog.
issues.action: Kept: details and sources are right.
